ipc_acceptance_policy.basis: Conservative acceptance after user correction; supplied assignment does not specify an aggregation rule.

timing.reset: synchronous, timed as ordinary input, no false paths
timing.scope: cell-only pre-layout RVT TT 0.7V 25C; not physical signoff

raw_mapping.commit_scope: workspace Git context; exact synthesis inputs are identified by sources_sha256
raw_mapping.bit_optimization: ABC topological structural hashing; optional explicit rewriting; no global bit opt_merge

synthesis.scope: Whole CPU, cell-only ASAP7 RVT TT; ideal clock, zero I/O delays, no parasitics or place-and-route.

mechanisms.scope: Architectural differential plus v2 RAT invariants and event coverage; old four-wide/replay event requirements do not apply.

mechanism_counter_scope: Cycles containing each event; simultaneous events of one kind may count once.

export.commit_scope: workspace Git context; exact inputs are identified by sources_sha256

generated_only_warning_exceptions.DECLFILENAME: single Verilog artifact contains multiple modules
generated_only_warning_exceptions.ASCRANGE: sv2v emits ascending [0:1] function jump helpers

limits: Timing is cell-only ASAP7 RVT TT with ideal clock, zero I/O delays and no wire parasitics; no place-and-route signoff.
